name: Blue Sky Farm and Orchard
description: Blue Sky Farm and Orchard is a working farm in Bluefield, WV. It grows Blackberries, Apples, Peaches, and Cherries, with seasonal availability through summer and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Jun – Aug in this growing zone.
